Bitcoin/Address.taprootSecretKey.notes: Published bitcoin 0.2.1 Jacobi/Common scalar and curve primitives plus Hash.taggedHash compose the complete empty-tree BIP341 secret-key tweak. Both public-key derivation and the existing even-Y secret-tweak composition execute inside timing; scalar lengths/ranges, root length and nonzero result are checked. Pure Motoko Nat/NAF secret arithmetic is variable-time reference code; it does not share the native constant-time security contract. Output scalar bytes match the independent affine oracle exactly.

Bitcoin/Transaction.TaprootHasher.signat.notes: Closest published bitcoin 0.2.1 createTaprootKeySpendSignatureHash one-shot operation versus the plugin prepared hasher first cold signatureHash call. Both compute input 0 SIGHASH_DEFAULT on the identical ten-input/two-output transaction, with equal 34-byte spent scripts and no annex. Package transaction/script parsing and native prepareTaproot occur outside timing. Native lazy common hashes are cold and included; the pure package recomputes its common hashes per call and exposes no retained cache. Any ratio describes uncached package operation versus prepared-cold plugin operation, not equivalent reusable-hasher APIs.
